claims.text: A remote scorer Signal automatically scores each individual LLM span, each tool span and the entire conversation.
It guarantees that all three levels receive scores even when the turn has not ended.

issues: S1 directly contradicts the answer: it says individual LLM and tool spans and whole conversations aren't remote scoring targets.
S1 says Weave scores only completed turns, triggered when a root span ends. It does not score turns that haven't ended, so the 'guarantee' is invented.

Correct answer: a remote scorer signal scores each completed agent turn, i.e. a root span's ended turn. The worker sends the turn's span and its messages to your HTTP endpoint and writes the response as feedback on the turn.
Revise partial or unsupported material claims.
